results.content: This study developed the Deep Vein Thrombosis Prophylaxis Motivation Scale (DVT-PMS) grounded in Protection Motivation Theory and evaluated its psychometric properties in post-arthroplasty patients. This study adopted a mixed-methods design to assess the reliability and validity of the "Chinese version of the Postoperative Anticoagulation Motivation Scale for Deep Vein Thrombosis Prophylaxis in Patients After Arthroplasty," based on Protection Motivation Theory, conducted sequentially in two stages. ### Scientific validity of the motivation scale for medication protection for Deep Vein thrombosis prophylaxis in Post-Arthroplasty patients. This careful development process ensures that the scale effectively and efficiently assesses the motivation of patients on anticoagulant medication for deep vein thrombosis prophylaxis after arthroplasty, and it has strong scientific validity. ### Reliability and validity of the motivation scale for medication protection for Deep Vein thrombosis prophylaxis in post-arthroplasty patients.
